title: Vinyl & Vehicle Wrapping
seoTitle: Vehicle Wrapping and Vinyl Graphics in Istanbul
description: Vehicle wrapping, window film, façade and cooler wrapping with Avery Dennison vinyl. Applied in 1–4 working days, 2-year warranty, free site survey in Istanbul.
heroDesc: We apply Avery Dennison and 3M vinyl to vehicles, building façades, glass and interior surfaces. Our team is experienced in large-scale work such as full fleet wraps and complete façade coverage, and we offer one-way vision, decorative and functional films.
listDesc: Vehicle wrapping, façade vinyl, window film, one-way vision and cut vinyl lettering. Full and partial wrap solutions.

process.title: Measurement and Design
process.desc: We take measurements and photographs and prepare the design around your corporate identity, logo and colours.

process.title: Printing and Cutting
process.desc: Once the artwork is approved, the vinyl is printed and precision cut.

process.title: Surface Preparation and Application

process.desc: Edges are sealed, air bubbles worked out, and the work is inspected and cleaned before handover.

faq.q: How long does a vehicle wrap take?
faq.a: Two to five days depending on the size of the vehicle: two to three days to print the vinyl after artwork approval, then two to three days to apply it.

faq.q: What determines the cost of a vehicle wrap?
faq.a: The vehicle model, the complexity of the design, how much of the body is covered and the grade of vinyl. Send us the vehicle model and what you want covered and we will quote free of charge.
Premium Avery Dennison and 3M vinyl is rated for five to seven years outdoors, and lasts longer with careful cleaning and maintenance.

faq.q: Will removing the vinyl damage the vehicle?
faq.a: Removed professionally, no. Damage is only a risk where vinyl has been left on far beyond its rated life and the paint underneath has already deteriorated.

faq.q: Does window film help with heat?
faq.a: Yes. Some films block up to 99% of UV and reduce heat gain, which can lower the interior temperature of a vehicle by three to five degrees in summer.

faq.q: Can you wrap a whole fleet?
faq.a: Yes. We handle fleet rollouts to a single specification, scheduling vehicles in batches so your operation is not interrupted.
